# Support

| Topic | Channel |
|---|---|
| Setup, Compose, DSN, “how do I…?” | [Discussions](https://github.com/epure-sh/epure/discussions) |
| Bugs / SDK ingest gaps | [Issues](https://github.com/epure-sh/epure/issues) — [bug](https://github.com/epure-sh/epure/issues/new?template=01-bug.yml) or [compat](https://github.com/epure-sh/epure/issues/new?template=02-compat.yml) |
| Security | [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) — private advisory or `security@news.epure.sh` |
| Conduct | `conduct@news.epure.sh` — [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) |
| Other mail | `support@news.epure.sh` |

Before opening an issue: `/health` is ok, note image tag + OS/arch, search existing threads. For SDK bugs include language, package, version, and a sanitized payload if you can.

**Docs:** [epure.sh/docs](https://epure.sh/docs) · develop locally: [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) · ingest OpenAPI: [docs/ingest.openapi.yaml](../docs/ingest.openapi.yaml)

No Discord. Optional managed hosting is separate: [epure.sh](https://epure.sh).
